title_of(html: str) -> str =
  pre html.char_count() >= 0
  post out.char_count() <= html.char_count()
  ex title_of("<title>Hi</title>") == "Hi"
  ex title_of("no title here") == ""
  let opened = html.split("<title>")
  let rest = opened.get(1) else return ""
  let closed = rest.split("</title>")
  if closed.len() < 2
    return ""
  closed[0].copy()

test_title_of() =
  assert title_of("<title>Hi</title>") == "Hi"
  assert title_of("no title here") == ""
  assert title_of("<title>Open only") == ""
